keyframe_review.note: New keyframe (Cliopatria lacks Yu). The List of Zhou dynasty states row gives 1046-655 BCE, conquered by Jin, Pinglu County near Xia County, Shanxi; no area. The 22 km disc is a stand-in for a county-sized state.

ledger.note: 1046: the Zhou fief of Yu begins. The list's row for Yu (虞國) gives '1046-655 BCE'; the page gives no enfeoffment sentence.

region.text: Yu, Pinglu County near Xia County, Shanxi (List of Zhou dynasty states)

ledger.note: 655: Jin conquers Yu after Guo. 'Jin first asked permission of the state of Yu to pass through its territory'; 'After conquering Guo it conquered Yu.' The Western Guo page dates the conquest of Guo to 655; the list gives 655 for Yu.

region.text: Yu, Pinglu County near Xia County, Shanxi (List of Zhou dynasty states)

ledger.note: 655: the state of Yu ends in Jin's conquest (list: 'Jin; 655 BCE'). The Western Guo page gives no year for Yu itself and says nothing of its land afterwards.

wars.name: Jin conquest of Guo and Yu

zones.text: Yu, Pinglu County near Xia County, Shanxi (List of Zhou dynasty states)

wars.outcome: Jin was allowed through Yu to destroy Western Guo and then conquered Yu in the same campaign (the borrowed-road stratagem).
wars.note: See the western-guo dossier; the Yu leg of the campaign is undated on the Western Guo page.

certainty.note: No Yu boundary is on either page; soft throughout.

notes: Pages opened (2 of 1-2): Western Guo, List of Zhou dynasty states. Wikipedia has no Yu article under these titles (the disambiguation page has a red link 'Yu (Chinese state)'), so identity.wikipedia is null and both pages are secondary: the year 655 and the site come from the list row, the story of the borrowed road from the Western Guo page. Wikidata id left null (unreachable). START -1046 is the list row's, not a sentence; no capital, rulers or area are on either page; the coordinates are the researcher's reading of 'Pinglu County, near Xia County'. The jin dossier carries Yu in a catch-all 676 gain; this dossier gives 655. Not to be confused with the Yu 虞 in the Wu genealogy or Yu the Great.
